column1: # Example load-project table. Copy it to ~/.config/load-project/projects.tsv
# (or point LOAD_PROJECT_TABLE at your copy) and replace these rows with your own.
# "name" is what you pass to `load-project`. "directory" is the project root
# IntelliJ opens and the shell starts in (~ is expanded; relative --add-dir
# paths resolve against it). "arguments" is everything after `claude`.
# Columns must be separated by TABs, not spaces. Blank lines and # are ignored.
# A project whose session can also read a sibling repo; resumes the session named "api".
# A front end that works alongside the api checkout.
# A plain project: just name the session and resume it.
